data.name: Brass
data.description: The power of dragons flows through you and manifests in a number of ways. At 1st level, you must select one of the chromatic or metallic dragon types (see the Pathfinder RPG Bestiary). This choice cannot be changed. A number of your abilities grant resistances and deal damage based on your dragon type. Brass dragons are associated with the fire energy type and have a 60-foot line breath shape.
